description: Wind Loads on Multi-Level Roof Buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Ioannis Zisis, Florida International University (fiu.edu). This dataset includes files from an extensive wind tunnel study of stepped-roof buildings conducted at the Wall of Wind facility at Florida International University. The aim of the study was to clarify the key factors that affect aerodynamic forces on complex architectural shapes. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: peak negative pressure coefficients, peak positive pressure coefficients. Published 2024-05-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
